items.headline: Energy One recurring revenue climbs in FY2026
items.summary: Energy One reported FY2026 recurring revenue up 17% to roughly A$63.5 million, with larger energy trading implementation projects moving toward go-live, according to CTRM Center coverage.

items.headline: REMIT II reporting duties take effect April 2026
items.summary: REMIT II introduces three reporting tiers with shorter deadlines, including bilateral OTC contracts due within 10 working days instead of a month, plus new exposure reporting above 600 GWh starting Q1 2027.

items.headline: VLCC freight rates now drive crude price spreads
items.summary: VLCC freight rates for US Gulf Coast-to-Asia crude cargoes have jumped to $30-35 per barrel from about $5 in 2025, meaning shipping costs, not supply alone, now shape who profits from crude trades.

items.headline: JPMorgan expands India trade finance partnership
items.summary: JPMorgan Payments is widening its risk-sharing partnership with the Asian Development Bank to improve working capital and trade finance access for businesses across India.
